1.  anthropic_sdk::caching - Rust
    Prompt caching lets you reuse a previously processed prefix of a prompt across requests. In this crate the cache is controlled per content block via CacheControl::Ephemeral, which marks the block and everything before it as cacheable.
    docs.rs/anthropic-sdk/latest/anthropic_sdk/caching/index.html
 
2.  Prompt caching with Claude \ Anthropic
    Prompt caching, now available on the Anthropic API, enables developers to cache frequently used context between API calls. Customers can provide Claude with more background knowledge and example outputs while reducing costs by up to 90% & latency by up to 85% for long prompts. Cache entries have a five minute lifetime, refreshed each time the cached content is read, and cache writes cost more than base input tokens while reads cost substantially less — which is what makes the technique pay for itself after roughly two reads of the same prefix.
    www.anthropic.com/news/prompt-caching
